platforms.name: Telegram
platforms.description: Run Hermes from Telegram DMs, groups, and topics.

env_vars.description: Complete Telegram bot token created by @BotFather (numeric bot ID followed by a colon and secret)
Optional comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs allowed immediately; leave blank to approve new users through DM pairing
Secret token Telegram sends with each webhook update (required with TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_URL)

platforms.name: Discord
platforms.description: Connect Hermes to Discord DMs, channels, and threads.

env_vars.description: Discord bot token from Developer Portal
Comma-separated Discord user IDs allowed to use the bot

platforms.name: Slack
platforms.description: Use Hermes from Slack via Socket Mode. Add allowed Slack member IDs so connected bots can respond.

env_vars.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-). Get from OAuth & Permissions after installing your app. Required scopes: chat:write, app_mentions:read, channels:history, groups:history, im:history, im:read, im:write, mpim:history, mpim:read, users:read, files:read, files:write
env_vars.help: In your Slack app, add the required bot scopes, install the app to the workspace, then copy OAuth & Permissions > Bot User OAuth Token.

env_vars.description: Slack app-level token (xapp-) for Socket Mode. Get from Basic Information → App-Level Tokens. Also ensure Event Subscriptions include: message.im, message.channels, message.groups, message.mpim, app_mention
env_vars.help: In your Slack app, enable Socket Mode, then create Basic Information > App-Level Tokens with the connections:write scope.

env_vars.description: Comma-separated Slack member IDs allowed to use Hermes, e.g. U01ABC2DEF3. Without this, Slack may connect but deny messages by default.
env_vars.help: In Slack, open your profile, choose More or the three-dot menu, then Copy member ID. Add multiple IDs comma-separated.

platforms.name: A2A
platforms.description: No extra packages needed (stdlib only)

env_vars.description: Name advertised on this agent's Agent Card (default: hostname-derived).
Shared bearer token for inbound A2A calls (identity falls back to caller IP). With no token of any kind => bind to 127.0.0.1 only (no remote access).
env_vars.prompt: A2A shared bearer token (or empty for localhost-only)

env_vars.description: Inbound bind host. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; only widens to 0.0.0.0 when a bearer token is set AND you opt in here.
Per-peer bearer tokens ('alice:tok1,bob:tok2'). Each remote agent gets its own credential; the matched name is the authenticated identity used for rate limiting, trust, and audit.
env_vars.prompt: A2A per-peer tokens (name:token, comma-separated; or empty)

env_vars.description: Inbound A2A server port (default 9900).
HMAC secret for signing push notifications (default: the shared bearer token).
